name: drssth/ModelNet-simscan
description:
load the simulated scan with code
df_scan = pd.read_hdf(filename, key=scan_pattern)

where filename is the .h5 file name (e.g., SimulatedScans/cy0-cz0-s1.0-d1.5/airplane/train/airplane_0001/airplane_0001-rotation22.5-directx.h5); scan_pattern is set with scan_pattern = 'lissajous', scan_pattern = 'raster', or scan_pattern = 'raster_r'.
'lissajous' indicates Lissajous scan mode describe in the paper, and 'raster' for Raster scan mode. ('raster_r' is another Raster scan mode that the frame ends… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/drssth/ModelNet-simscan.
